# CANDIDATE: ATR_COMPRESSION_VWAP_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When volatility contracts to a low ATR relative to its recent average and price hovers near VWAP, a breakout with volume expansion often yields a sustained move. This setup captures mean-reversion exhaustion in low-volatility environments, where VWAP acts as dynamic support/resistance and volume-confirmed breakouts signal institutional participation.

## Mechanism

Compute ATR14 and its 20-period EMA (ATR_EMA20). If ATR14 < 0.4 * ATR_EMA20 AND |close‑VWAP| < 0.1*ATR20 AND the next bar closes > VWAP + 0.2*ATR20 with volume > 1.3 * average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter long at the close of that breakout bar. Exit shape: Initial stop at the most recent swing low (chart‑stop), TP1 at 2R, runner trailed using a chandelier exit (ATR20 * 3). Regime hint: Best when VIX < 20, time 09:45-10:45, and the 5‑minute VWAP is not trending sharply (|VWAP slope| < 0.07% per bar). Avoid FOMC, CPI, and major earnings releases.
